title: SignandGo
description: Comprehensive digital signature and document control platform engineered for users to execute agreements seamlessly with end-to-end auditability and compliance at every stage.
impact: Streamlines document lifecycles by drastically cutting turnaround times, ensuring legal validity, cryptographic integrity, and real-time status tracking for all signers.

title: The Crawler
description: Automation suite featuring a Chrome extension (Manifest V3) paired with a web orchestration platform. Leverages Playwright and AI/LLMs to automate browser navigation, scraping workflows, and complex repetitive web actions.
impact: Eliminates countless hours of tedious manual browsing workflows, allowing teams to launch headless automation and data extraction with a single click.

title: Karla Smile
description: Cross-platform mobile application built in Flutter with a Django backend for event logistics and 360° rotating video booths. Features dynamic video capture, music overlays, custom visual filters, and framed branding assets.
impact: Processes and distributes personalized video clips to event attendees in real time via high-throughput cloud delivery pipelines.

title: check.lo justo
description: Official public web platform providing open-access metrology calibration tools (Dissolved Oxygen, pH, Electrical Conductivity, Benson & Krause solubility tables) and matrix exports.
impact: Enables laboratories, engineers, and industrial teams to instantly verify and calibrate physicochemical sensor parameters with zero friction.

title: The Wasppers
description: Custom enterprise-grade messaging center modeled after WhatsApp Web with native Dark and Light mode support, multi-line concurrent routing, autonomous AI agent integration, and smart bots.
impact: Engineered custom for high-volume customer support and sales logistics. Integrates low-latency WebSockets, automated human vs. bot triage (JustoBot), and dynamic lead routing.

title: Vicuña Rise
description: Action-platformer video game crafted with Godot Engine, featuring a rich Andean pixel art aesthetic, custom dynamic 2D/3D physics mechanics, and optimized visual shaders.
impact: In final development and performance optimization stage ahead of its upcoming official launch on the App Store and Google Play Store.
metrics: Coming soon to App Store & Play Store
